about: What the Node terminal UI needs that the v2 protocol or the projection does not provide yet, found by tests/protocol_coverage.rs over tui-store-calls.json and tui-state-fields.json. The test asserts the missing set equals this file, so the file only shrinks: nr-tui-core-gaps implements each entry in the core and empties it.

methods.name: getSettingsSnapshot
methods.note: one read of the settings picker's rows (autoClear, toolModules, compaction, systemShell, outputStyle, mcp, plugins, skills, webSearchRoute, profile, updateSettings); the operations map lists the action as caller-less, the TUI calls it

methods.name: inspectProjectPath
methods.note: classifies a typed path (exists, is a folder, is registered) before the project picker adds it; not in the operations map

methods.name: rememberPromptHistory
methods.note: the prompt just submitted joins the up-arrow list; the core's thread/promptHistory/updated `added` change exists, a method to record one does not

methods.name: restoreNewerTranscript
methods.note: pages the transcript window toward newer rows; the core keeps the whole log and the snapshot carries hasOlder: a page read of items or an inert answer is needed

methods.name: restoreOlderTranscript
methods.note: pages the transcript window toward older rows (thread/items/list pages it; the store task decides whether this is that call)

methods.name: setProgressHint
methods.note: the progress-hint toggle of the settings picker; the hint is a runtime section field (progressHint) with no setter method
